SETTINGS_PAGE.TITLE: System Settings
SETTINGS_PAGE.PURPOSE_TEXT: The Settings module allows administrators to configure and manage the application's core features, security, users, workflows, and system preferences.
SETTINGS_PAGE.WHAT_YOU_CAN_DO_LIST:
• Manage tenants and organizational information.
• Configure users, roles, and permissions.
• Set up workflows and approval processes.
• Manage notifications and system preferences.
• Configure integrations and other administrative settings.
SETTINGS_PAGE.NOTE_TEXT: Changes made in this section may affect the entire system. Only authorized administrators should modify system settings to ensure security, consistency, and proper application operation.

CONFIGURATION_PAGE.PURPOSE_TEXT: Configuration Management allows administrators to configure and maintain system-wide settings that control the behavior, security, and operational features of the application.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.WHAT_YOU_CAN_DO_LIST:
• Configure email settings.
• Configure SMS settings.
• Manage notification preferences.
• View and manage audit logs.
• Customize system behavior.
• Save and update configuration settings.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.NOTE_TEXT: Configuration settings affect the entire system. Changes should only be performed by authorized administrators to ensure system stability, security, and consistent operation.

PERMISSION_SETTING_PAGE.PURPOSE_TEXT: Permission Management allows administrators to define and control what actions users are allowed to perform within the system.
PERMISSION_SETTING_PAGE.WHAT_YOU_CAN_DO_LIST:
• Create new permissions.
• View all available permissions.
• Update permission details.
• Assign permissions to roles.
• Enable or disable permissions.
• Organize permissions by modules.
PERMISSION_SETTING_PAGE.NOTE_TEXT: Permissions determine the actions users can perform. They are usually assigned to roles, and users inherit permissions through their assigned roles.
